API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPublicUpdate Ec Group
Update Ec Group
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ecgroup/:id

Update Ec Group

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
int32
REQUIRED
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
id
int32

ID of Cloud or Branch Connector group.

name
string

Name of Cloud or Branch Connector group.

desc
string

Description of Cloud or Branch Connector group.

deployType
string

Deployment type of Cloud or Branch Connector group.

Possible values: [ONPREM, CLOUD, DISABLED, MON_DELETED, DELETING, DELETING_LAST, DELETED]

status
string[]

string
